serviceCapacity.source: flexcar.service_capacities for allocatedMin; each bucket's own table for bookedMin (capacity_bookings Order / maintenance_bookings / unassigned_services); service_capacities reserved_minutes carried only as ledgerBookedMin
serviceCapacity.note: allocatedMin = modelled minutes set aside; bookedMin = authoritative booked minutes from the bucket's own table; ledgerBookedMin = service_capacities reserved_minutes, which lags intermittently and is kept only so the divergence stays visible; onFlexService.bookedMin is whole-job estimated minutes while its ledgerBookedMin is remaining minutes, so those two are not expected to agree even when the ledger is healthy; null means no service_capacities row, not zero capacity

orderCapacity.note: static per-lot admin settings, not a per-day series: the same ceiling applies to every day of the window until the lot is edited; daily_order_capacity is the admin UI's 'Daily Pickup & Swap Capacity', not an all-order ceiling; null means not configured, which is not a ceiling of zero
